utterances.text: Hello dear, how have you been?
Hi Grandma! I've been good, just busy with school and stuff. How about you?
Oh, thank you, dear! I didn't realize I was that hungry.
I'm glad you're eating well, Grandma! What have you been up to lately?
Oh, I see! Thank you for explaining that to me. I'm glad you liked my dance.
It's always fun to learn new things from you. What else is new in your world?
I've been busy with school and trying to keep up with everything. It's a bit overwhelming sometimes.
Thank you, dear! I'm always trying my best. Is there anything else exciting happening with you?
Well, I did start a new hobby recently. I've been learning to play the guitar, and it's been really fun!
I'm glad to hear that! You always have such interesting stories. Anything else you'd like to share?
Thanks! I've also been thinking about joining a band at school. It sounds like a great way to meet new people.
Oh my, that sounds like quite the performance! I'm not sure I understand everything, but it sounds exciting. Can you tell me more about it?
Sure! It's basically a group of us playing different instruments together. We practice and perform songs, and it's a lot of fun!
It sounds like you're having a lot of fun! I'm curious about what you're doing. Can you explain it a bit more?
Of course! We usually meet after school to practice. I'm learning to play the guitar, and it's been a great experience so far.
Oh, I see! It looks like you're showing me something interesting. I'm trying to follow along. Can you show me again?
It sounds like you're having a great time with all these activities! I'm curious too, what exactly are you doing?
Sure! I'm part of a band with my friends, and we practice after school. I'm learning to play the guitar, and it's been really fun!
It seems like you're counting something. Are you practicing a dance or a routine?
No, I'm not dancing. I'm just counting the beats for the song we're practicing. It's a bit tricky, but I'm getting the hang of it!
I'm glad you think it's beautiful! It must be something special. Can you tell me more about it?
Sure! We're working on a new song that has a really cool rhythm. It's challenging but super rewarding when we get it right.
Oh, I can't wait to see what you do next! It sounds like you're having so much fun with the butterflies. I'm ready to watch you!
Thanks, Grandma! I'm really excited to show you what we've been working on. It's going to be amazing!
